title: Disruption of cell-type-specific molecular programs of striatal spiny projection neurons in autism
title_zh: 自闭症中纹状体棘状投影神经元细胞类型特异性分子程序的破坏
abstract: Rare genetic variants contribute substantially to autism spectrum disorder (ASD), yet the regulatory logic of vulnerable subcortical cells is poorly understood. In a 16p11.2 deletion mouse model, lineage tracing across five brain regions revealed prominent striatal changes. In the human putamen from ASD and neurotypical donors, single-nucleus multi-omics showed transcriptional alterations concentrated in D1 striosome spiny projection neurons (SPNs), affecting synaptic and energy metabolism genes, with altered synapse-supporting programs in astrocytes. Gene regulatory network analysis integrating chromatin accessibility and expression identified EGR1 and EGR3 as key regulators of these programs, with reduced activity in D1 striosome SPNs. Deleting EGR1 or EGR3 in human striatal organoids produced partially overlapping transcriptional changes. These findings establish the striatum as a site of molecular convergence in ASD and provide a multi-omic resource for dissecting subcortical mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 罕见遗传变异对自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）有重大贡献，但易损亚皮质细胞的调控逻辑尚不清楚。在16p11.2缺失小鼠模型中，跨五个脑区的血统追踪揭示了显著的纹状体改变。在来自ASD捐赠者和神经典型捐赠者的人类壳核中，单核多组学显示转录改变集中于D1纹状体束棘状投影神经元（SPNs），影响突触和能量代谢基因，星形胶质细胞中突触支持程序也发生改变。整合染色质可及性和表达的基因调控网络分析确定EGR1和EGR3是这些程序的关键调控因子，且D1纹状体束SPNs中其活性降低。在人类纹状体类器官中删除EGR1或EGR3产生了部分重叠的转录改变。这些发现确立了纹状体作为ASD中分子收敛位点，并为解析亚皮质机制提供了一个多组学资源。
